references.text: Psalm 22:18 describes a scene where the clothes of the suffering one are divided, which mirrors the event in Matthew 27:31 where Jesus' clothes are handled by the soldiers.
Isaiah 50:6 contains prophecies about sufferings that include humiliations, which can be seen as parallel to the humiliation Jesus experienced in Matthew 27:31.
In Philippians 2:7-8 it is spoken of Christ who humbled himself and became obedient to death, even death on a cross, which is consistent with the events in Matthew 27:31.
